business.description: Mukka Proteins Limited is a diversified marine and sustainable protein company engaged in manufacturing and supplying Fish Protein products (Fish Meal, Fish Oil, Fish Soluble Paste) and Alternate Protein products (Insect Meal, Insect Oil, Insect Compost, Humic Acid, Briquettes). The company has expanded into Waste Management through Leachate Management solutions and Frozen & Value-Added Products (Surimi, Crustaceans, Cephalopods, Scombroid/Non-Scombroid fish products).

outlook.statement: Committed to ambition of exceeding ₹3,000 crore in revenue by FY30, supported by organic growth, capacity expansion, value-added products, international expansion and strategic opportunities

Climate-related events such as El Niño may create both opportunities and challenges for marine-ingredients industry; diversified business model, international presence, alternate-protein platform and disciplined operating approach position company well for long-term growth
Focused on cost optimization, deleveraging, working-capital discipline and prudent capital allocation to ensure sustainable and value-accretive growth

Global aquaculture growth continues with aquaculture supplying essentially all incremental growth; feed-grade aquatic-animal demand forecast to grow faster than food-use demand (+5.8% to 17.4 MMT vs +1.6% for direct human consumption)

Rabobank projects continued but uneven species-level growth for calendar 2026: carp +6%, sea bass/bream +4%, shrimp and tilapia +3%, salmon and pangasius +2%; shift toward carnivorous premium finfish species will increase fishmeal demand
India's fisheries sector targets doubling export earnings toward ₹1 lakh crore over medium term; Union Budget 2026-27 allocated record ₹2,761.80 crore to fisheries sector

Insect protein market projected to scale from USD 45-65 million (2026) to USD 280-420 million by 2035 in India; substituting 10% of India's fishmeal consumption with BSF meal would create ~₹2,000 crore opportunity
Oman facility at Aljoubah Industrial Area expected to commence operations over coming quarters, adding ~400 TPD capacity

Aspiration to more than double consolidated revenue from ₹1,449 crore in FY26 to over ₹3,000 crore by FY30, driven by integration across four verticals, disciplined organic and inorganic expansion (including Oman and Sri Lanka initiatives), and backward integration into fishing/raw-material assets.
Structurally tight global fishmeal and fish oil supply environment likely to remain supportive of realisations through at least first half of FY27, pending clarity on Peru's anchovy catch recovery.
Fast-growing insect-protein and waste-management categories continue to benefit from strengthening regulatory and ESG tailwinds.
Record fisheries allocation in Union Budget 2026-27 and continued duty rationalisation should support broader value chain.
Easing of US tariffs on Indian goods should benefit frozen and value-added seafood exports.

The Company approved strategic investments in the partnership firm 'MPL FC HRC JV' and the proposed overseas entity 'Lanka Bio Proteins Private Limited', Sri Lanka. The Company proposes to make a capital contribution of ₹2.55 lakh representing 51% profit-sharing ratio in MPL FC HRC JV and invest up to ₹2.50 crore in Lanka Bio Proteins Private Limited representing 49% shareholding. These investments are expected to support the Company's business expansion, strengthen operational synergies, and enhance its presence in domestic and international markets.

The Company will continue to focus on strengthening and expanding its core and non-core businesses and enhancing its presence in domestic and international markets. These initiatives are expected to improve productivity, optimize operations, and support sustainable growth in revenue and profitability.
